title: Penthouse Magazine January 2002 Special Pet of the Year Bill O'Reilly Ben Stein
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible cover wear, spine wear or address label. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Penthouse Magazine, January 2002 - Special Issue, Pet of the Year.

Contributors and interviews in this issue include Ben Stein, Bill O'Reilly, Sarah Silverman, Anthony Kiedis, Alan Dershowitz, Luis Royo and Dawn Robinson.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage. Glossy cover stock with the usual shelf wear.
